stories.name: scaffold-and-health
stories.title: Project scaffold, CORS, and health endpoint
stories.description: Create bridge/server.py with FastAPI app, CORS middleware (chrome-extension://* and moz-extension://*), GET /api/health endpoint. Create bridge/requirements.txt (mempalace, fastapi, uvicorn, pytest, httpx), bridge/Dockerfile, docker-compose.yml. Set up pytest with FastAPI TestClient for testing. The health endpoint calls tool_status() to get drawer count.

stories.name: write-endpoints
stories.title: Drawer CRUD endpoints (POST, PUT, DELETE)
stories.description: Implement POST /api/drawers (create drawer with custom metadata stored in ChromaDB), PUT /api/drawers/{id} (update content/metadata), DELETE /api/drawers/{id}. For POST, access ChromaDB collection directly to store extended metadata (source_url, title, hall, timestamp) alongside standard MemPalace fields. Use tool_update_drawer and tool_delete_drawer for PUT/DELETE. Add Pydantic models for request/response validation. Tests for each endpoint including error cases.

stories.name: read-endpoints
stories.title: Read endpoints and by-url duplicate detection
stories.description: Implement GET /api/search (wraps tool_search), GET /api/status (wraps tool_status), GET /api/taxonomy (wraps tool_get_taxonomy), GET /api/wings (wraps tool_list_wings), GET /api/rooms (wraps tool_list_rooms with optional wing param), GET /api/drawers/by-url (query ChromaDB metadata for source_url match, return exists/drawer_id/title). Tests for each endpoint. The by-url endpoint requires direct ChromaDB collection access to query by metadata field.
